The pairing code is incorrect or too man.zh-Hant: 配對碼錯誤或嘗試次數過多，請在 iMusic 中重新開啓上傳。

The source file changed or was removed..en: The source file changed or was removed. Resume to reopen it, or relink its folder in Settings.
The source file changed or was removed..zh-Hans: 源文件已更改或移除。请继续播放以重新打开文件，或在设置中重新关联文件夹。
The source file changed or was removed..zh-Hant: 來源檔案已變更或移除。請繼續播放以重新開啟檔案，或在設定中重新關聯資料夾。

The source file changed. Scan Linked Fol.en: The source file changed. Scan Linked Folders in Settings before playing it again.
The source file changed. Scan Linked Fol.zh-Hans: 源文件已更改。请在设置中扫描关联文件夹后重新播放。
The source file changed. Scan Linked Fol.zh-Hant: 來源檔案已變更。請在設定中掃描關聯資料夾後重新播放。

This file cannot be decoded. It may be d.en: This file cannot be decoded. It may be damaged or in an unsupported format.
This file cannot be decoded. It may be d.zh-Hans: 无法解码此文件，文件可能损坏或格式不受支持。
This file cannot be decoded. It may be d.zh-Hant: 無法解碼此檔案，檔案可能損壞或格式不受支持。

This file exceeds the upload size limit..en: This file exceeds the upload size limit.
This file exceeds the upload size limit..zh-Hans: 此文件超过上传大小限制。
This file exceeds the upload size limit..zh-Hant: 此檔案超過上傳大小限制。

This is a local build. iCloud requires a.en: This is a local build. iCloud requires a developer team, a CloudKit container, and a Cloud build configuration.
This is a local build. iCloud requires a.zh-Hans: 当前为本地构建。iCloud 需要配置开发者团队、CloudKit 容器并使用 Cloud 构建配置。
This is a local build. iCloud requires a.zh-Hant: 當前為本地構建。iCloud 需要配置開發者團隊、CloudKit 容器並使用 Cloud 構建配置。

This legacy folder imported copies. Reli.en: This legacy folder imported copies. Relink to index originals; existing copies will be kept.
This legacy folder imported copies. Reli.zh-Hans: 此旧版关联文件夹已导入音频副本。重新关联可索引源文件，已有副本将保留。
This legacy folder imported copies. Reli.zh-Hant: 此舊版關聯資料夾已匯入音訊副本。重新關聯可索引來源檔案，現有副本將保留。

This playlist was permanently deleted. C.en: This playlist was permanently deleted. Create a new playlist instead.
This playlist was permanently deleted. C.zh-Hans: 此歌单已被永久删除，请创建新歌单。
This playlist was permanently deleted. C.zh-Hant: 此歌單已被永久刪除，請建立新歌單。

This record is too large to sync with iC.en: This record is too large to sync with iCloud. Your local information has been preserved.
This record is too large to sync with iC.zh-Hans: 此记录过大，无法同步到 iCloud；本地内容已保留。
This record is too large to sync with iC.zh-Hant: 此記錄過大，無法同步到 iCloud；本地內容已保留。

This song uses an external source file..en: This song uses an external source file.
This song uses an external source file..zh-Hans: 此歌曲使用外部源文件。
This song uses an external source file..zh-Hant: 此歌曲使用外部來源檔案。

This song was permanently deleted. Impor.en: This song was permanently deleted. Import it again to add a new copy.
This song was permanently deleted. Impor.zh-Hans: 这首歌已永久删除。重新导入后才能添加新的副本。
This song was permanently deleted. Impor.zh-Hant: 這首歌已永久刪除。重新導入後才能添加新的副本。

Timed out waiting for the source file. R.en: Timed out waiting for the source file. Retry when it is available.
Timed out waiting for the source file. R.zh-Hans: 等待源文件超时，请在文件可用后重试。
Timed out waiting for the source file. R.zh-Hant: 等待來源檔案逾時，請在檔案可用後重試。

Try another song title, artist, or filen.en: Try another song title, artist, or filename.
Try another song title, artist, or filen.zh-Hans: 试试其他歌曲名、歌手或文件名。
Try another song title, artist, or filen.zh-Hant: 試試其他歌曲名、歌手或檔案名。

Unable to create the staging file..en: Unable to create the staging file.

Unable to finish cleaning up permanently.en: Unable to finish cleaning up permanently deleted files. Cleanup will be retried when iMusic opens again.
Unable to finish cleaning up permanently.zh-Hans: 歌曲已从资料库永久移除，但部分应用内文件未能清理。再次打开 iMusic 时会重试。
Unable to finish cleaning up permanently.zh-Hant: 歌曲已從資料庫永久移除，但部分應用內檔案未能清理。再次打開 iMusic 時會重試。

Upload complete. Check the import result.en: Upload complete. Check the import results in iMusic.
Upload complete. Check the import result.zh-Hans: 上传完成，请在 iMusic 中查看导入结果。
Upload complete. Check the import result.zh-Hant: 上傳完成，請在 iMusic 中查看導入結果。

Wi-Fi Upload resources are missing. Rebu.en: Wi-Fi Upload resources are missing. Rebuild iMusic.
Wi-Fi Upload resources are missing. Rebu.zh-Hans: Wi-Fi 传歌资源缺失，请重新构建 iMusic。
Wi-Fi Upload resources are missing. Rebu.zh-Hant: Wi-Fi 傳歌資源缺失，請重新建置 iMusic。

Your files stay on your local network..en: Your files stay on your local network.
Your files stay on your local network..zh-Hans: 文件仅通过本地网络传输。
Your files stay on your local network..zh-Hant: 檔案僅透過區域網路傳輸。

Your listening history appears here, wit.en: Your listening history appears here, without an internet connection.
Your listening history appears here, wit.zh-Hans: 收听记录会在这里呈现，无需联网。
Your listening history appears here, wit.zh-Hant: 收聽記錄會在這裡呈現，無需聯網。

format.backup.download_required.en: %1$@ is not downloaded. Download all music before creating a full backup.
format.backup.download_required.zh-Hans: %1$@ 尚未下载，完整备份前请先下载所有音乐。
format.backup.download_required.zh-Hant: %1$@ 尚未下載，完整備份前請先下載所有音樂。

format.backup.sources.en: Managed songs: %1$ld. Linked references: %2$ld. Linked audio and folder permissions are excluded; relink folders after restoring. Save this archive outside iMusic.
format.backup.sources.zh-Hans: 托管歌曲：%1$ld 首；关联引用：%2$ld 首。不包含关联音频和文件夹授权，恢复后需重新关联文件夹。请将备份保存到 iMusic 之外。
format.backup.sources.zh-Hant: 託管歌曲：%1$ld 首；關聯參照：%2$ld 首。不包含關聯音訊和資料夾授權，還原後需重新關聯資料夾。請將備份儲存到 iMusic 之外。

format.batch.instructions.en: Editing %1$ld songs. Only selected fields are applied; empty values clear those fields. Other tags and original files stay intact.

plural.one: Editing %1$ld song. Only selected fields are applied; empty values clear those fields. Other tags and original files stay intact.
plural.other: Editing %1$ld songs. Only selected fields are applied; empty values clear those fields. Other tags and original files stay intact.

format.batch.instructions.zh-Hans: 编辑 %1$ld 首歌曲。仅应用勾选字段；空内容将清除此字段。其他标签和原始文件保持完整。
format.batch.instructions.zh-Hant: 編輯 %1$ld 首歌曲。僅應用勾選字段；空內容將清除此字段。其他標籤和原始檔案保持完整。

format.import.copy_incomplete.en: %1$@: the previous copy was incomplete. Please import it again.
format.import.copy_incomplete.zh-Hans: %1$@：上次复制未完成，请重新导入。
format.import.copy_incomplete.zh-Hant: %1$@：上次複製未完成，請重新導入。

format.import.index_error.en: Unable to save the scan index: %1$@

format.import.summary.zh-Hans: 最近导入：%1$ld 首，重复 %2$ld 首
format.import.summary.zh-Hant: 最近導入：%1$ld 首，重復 %2$ld 首

format.library.summary.en: %1$ld songs · Offline and ready to play

plural.one: %1$ld song · Offline and ready to play
plural.other: %1$ld songs · Offline and ready to play

format.library.summary.zh-Hans: %1$ld 首歌曲 · 离线收藏，自由聆听
format.library.summary.zh-Hant: %1$ld 首歌曲 · 離線收藏，自由聆聽

format.playback.preload_error.en: Unable to preload the next song: %1$@

format.restore.missing.en: Library information restored. %1$ld songs still need to be imported or downloaded.

plural.one: Library information restored. %1$ld song still needs to be imported or downloaded.
plural.other: Library information restored. %1$ld songs still need to be imported or downloaded.

format.restore.missing.zh-Hans: 整理信息已恢复；有 %1$ld 首歌曲尚未导入或下载。
format.restore.missing.zh-Hant: 整理資訊已恢復；有 %1$ld 首歌曲尚未導入或下載。

format.trash.delete_count.en: %1$ld songs will be permanently removed from iMusic. Its managed copy on this device will be deleted. Source files and existing backups are kept. Library deletion records sync when iCloud is enabled.

plural.one: %1$ld song will be permanently removed from iMusic. Its managed copy on this device will be deleted. Source files and existing backups are kept. Library deletion records sync when iCloud is enabled.
plural.other: %1$ld songs will be permanently removed from iMusic. Its managed copy on this device will be deleted. Source files and existing backups are kept. Library deletion records sync when iCloud is enabled.

format.trash.delete_count.zh-Hans: 将从 iMusic 资料库永久移除 %1$ld 首歌曲，并删除这台设备上应用内的副本。导入来源文件和已有备份不受影响。启用 iCloud 时，删除记录会随资料库同步。
format.trash.delete_count.zh-Hant: 將從 iMusic 資料庫永久移除 %1$ld 首歌曲，並刪除這台裝置上應用內的副本。導入來源檔案和已有備份不受影響。啓用 iCloud 時，刪除記錄會隨資料庫同步。

format.trash.delete_playlist.en: “%1$@” and its playlist entries will be permanently removed. Songs and audio files will be kept.
format.trash.delete_playlist.zh-Hans: “%1$@”及其歌单条目将被永久删除。歌曲及音频文件会保留。
format.trash.delete_playlist.zh-Hant: 「%1$@」及其歌單項目將被永久刪除。歌曲及音訊檔案會保留。

format.trash.delete_song.en: “%1$@” will be permanently removed from iMusic. Its managed copy on this device will be deleted. Source files and existing backups are kept. Library deletion records sync when iCloud is enabled.
format.trash.delete_song.zh-Hans: 将从 iMusic 资料库永久移除“%1$@”，并删除这台设备上应用内的副本。导入来源文件和已有备份不受影响。启用 iCloud 时，删除记录会随资料库同步。
format.trash.delete_song.zh-Hant: 將從 iMusic 資料庫永久移除「%1$@」，並刪除這台裝置上應用內的副本。導入來源檔案和已有備份不受影響。啓用 iCloud 時，刪除記錄會隨資料庫同步。

iCloud is not configured in this build..en: iCloud is not configured in this build. Use a developer team with iCloud access and a Cloud build configuration.
iCloud is not configured in this build..zh-Hans: 此构建未配置 iCloud。请使用付费开发者团队和 Cloud 配置构建。
iCloud is not configured in this build..zh-Hant: 此構建未配置 iCloud。請使用付費開發者團隊和 Cloud 配置構建。
